# Files copied from toywasm's lib/ into src/toywasm/ by tools/vendor-toywasm.sh.
#
# This is the closure of what src/toywasm_config.h needs: the core
# interpreter, with no threads, WASI, dynamic linking, SIMD, exception
# handling or module writer. Headers were listed with `cc -MM` over the .c
# files below. Enabling a feature in toywasm_config.h can pull in more
# headers (insn_impl_simd.h, ...); add them here and re-vendor.
#
# Deliberately not vendored:
#   xlog.c nbio.c   stdout/stderr output; replaced by src/toywasm_shim.c
#   fileio.c        file loading; modules are read by R
#   cluster.c suspend.c waitlist.c lock.c usched.c shared_memory.c
#                   threads support
#   module_writer.c TOYWASM_ENABLE_WRITER is off
#   exec_debug.c    trace printers nothing in the library calls; also
#                   casts a function pointer to void *, which -pedantic
#                   rejects
#   *.in            CMake templates; src/toywasm_config.h replaces them
